findings.problem: One invalid RH/units/array could abort otherwise valid independent weather variables.
findings.fix: Canonical per-variable null/quality/reasons; reject only untrustworthy path envelopes/axes.

findings.problem: A negative rain component could be hidden by adding positive showers.
findings.fix: Validate both components before sum; boolean/nonfinite values are invalid.

findings.problem: Explicit OpenWeather rain:null was inferred zero by the omission rule.
findings.fix: Separate absent key from explicit null/malformed structure.

findings.problem: Adapter kind/unit/wind names did not match the main contract; first availability was overwritten on refetch.
findings.fix: One canonical sample contract, matching enums/units and explicit immutable-revision availability.
findings.tests: HandoffTests contract_valid_samples, first_availability, canonical_unit_validator; root verifier

findings.problem: Point wind was called a mean; Forecast gust period was lost and Archive gust needed product-specific handling.
findings.fix: Official product mappings preserve point wind, Forecast preceding-hour gust maximum and explicit CERRA distinction.

findings.problem: Older W11 returned disabled for flowering with missing applicable evidence.
findings.fix: Explicit AND/OR truth table; missing ->unknown, both arms false ->not_triggered, supported positive ->context_only.

findings.problem: Invalid W06/W10 flag/state combinations could bypass intended card routes; string gates were truthy.
findings.fix: Flag-specific display eligibility and strict boolean gates.

findings.problem: A malformed evaluator dataset could crash; requested split typos looked empty.
Pending outcomes could be hidden from selected-population accounting; two false-water denominators were easy to confuse.
findings.fix: Selected/pending counts, adjudication coverage, water recommendation precision and FP/recommendation alongside FP/negative.

findings.problem: Old collection template field names did not directly match the evaluator dataset.
findings.fix: Exact dataset contract with nonmechanical mapping and explicit missing fields; unconfigured dataset remains rejected.
findings.tests: Root verifier emptyUnconfiguredDatasetRejected; field evaluator tests

findings.problem: Documented captured_payload_tests.py was missing; task links depended on a local C: workspace; test execution modified delivered reports.
findings.fix: Ship the script with resolved fixture paths, portable root-relative package layout and temporary-copy verifier.
findings.tests: Captured payload suite, manifest/link checks and relocated extraction verification

findings.problem: Older partial reference behavior and app/validation readiness could be mistaken for current production rules.
findings.fix: One current master/contract, explicit reference-role table, legacy folder, dated report scope and task acceptance refinements.
findings.tests: Task DAG, acceptance coverage, fixed oracle integrity and disabled release checks

findings.problem: Nulling invalid provider RH could accidentally make it eligible for dewpoint fallback.
findings.fix: Quality-aware paired-air wrapper refuses invalid RH and mismatched source/time; missing RH alone can derive.
